title: suraj ye keh ke deen ka ubhra ghadeer me
body:
Suraj ye keh ke deen ka ubhra ghadeer mein.
Takmeel aaj paayega kalma ghadeer mein.
<<DIVIDER>>
Elaan-e-Jibraeel ye goonja ghadeer mein.
Maula banaaye jaatay hain Maula ghadeer mein.
<<DIVIDER>>
Bazoo buland kar ke dikhatay rahay Rasool. (x2)
Andhoan ne phir bhi kuch nahi dekha ghadeer mein. (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Sadiyoan ka faasla hai mere un ke darmiyaan. (x2)
Lekin main jaanta hoon ke main tha ghadeer mein.
<<DIVIDER>>
Quraa’n ki aayatoan ka safar intiha pe tha.
Thi ibtida pe nahj-e-balagah ghadeer mein.
<<DIVIDER>>
Rasta bhatak gaya tha musafir ghadeer ka.
Hur bas zara si dair se pohncha ghadeer mein.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ishq-e-Ali mein hota taqayya agar haraam.
Aayat kabhi badalti na lehja ghadeer mein.
<<DIVIDER>>
Lekin main jaanta hoon ke main tha ghadeer mein.
